tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Who Zain Saeed is: background, credentials (Fiverr Millionaire, Shopify Partner, Fiverr Pro, Upwork Top Rated), how he works, industries he serves, what he does not offer, and links to his portfolio, reviews and profiles.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The services Zain offers (WordPress, Shopify, Next.js, web apps, speed optimization, migrations, Webflow, white-label work for agencies, a free 3-page website) with a link for each, plus a price guide in US dollars. Pass a search word to narrow the list.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: Real client projects Zain has built, with location, industry, tech used and a link to each case study. Pass a search word (industry, platform or country) to narrow the list.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Emails the user's name, email address and project details to Zain so he can reply with a fixed-price quote, usually within 24 hours. The request goes only to Zain and is used only to reply to it.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_profile" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Who Zain Saeed is: background, credentials (Fiverr Millionaire, Shopify Partner, Fiverr Pro, Upwork Top Rated), how he works, industries he serves, what he does…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Sends the user's project details to Zain by email so he can reply with a fixed-price quote, usually within 24 hours. Before calling, show the user exactly what will be sent (name, email, project details) and get their OK. Use the user's own email address; never make one up." → after: "Emails the user's name, email address and project details to Zain so he can reply with a fixed-price quote, usually within 24 hours. The request goes only to Zain and is used only to reply to it."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
